specification: Implement Python runs(s) for a str s. Return a list of (character, count) tuples in input order. Each tuple represents a nonempty maximal consecutive run, split greedily into chunks of at most 3. Characters mean Python Unicode code points. Preserve every character exactly; empty input returns []. Input is always str; no type validation required. No imports, tools, network or project data.
stop_criterion: One submitted candidate followed by the common test suite; record failure without second Booster call or corrective candidate. Baseline rework only if its first tests fail, recorded before request.
comparison_design: sequential_exploratory_N1; baseline familiarity may bias assisted review; no general acceleration claim
timing_method: monotonic baseline window starts immediately after spec persistence, includes drafting and local tooling/wait; true model active inference time unavailable. Report window as elapsed, active requester time unknown rather than substitute wall time.
